limitations: Observed native state transitions and Decision receipts only; no optimal-action or causal-effect inference.
Horizontal reversals are compared only within unchanged piece, board, rotation and target context.
Strict overshoot requires crossing the chosen target column with the same piece, rotation and board.
Evaluation and promotion diagnostics are kept separate; neither feeds back into search or experience extraction.

stepwise_comparison_notes.episode_identity: Paired arms share episode_id by design; the distinct stage and artifact path bind each real run.
stepwise_comparison_notes.excluded: Network request IDs, response metadata, latency and wall-clock timing.
stepwise_comparison_notes.interpretation: Equality describes the selected policies on these paired seeds; it does not establish equal search power or efficacy of rejected proposals.
stepwise_comparison_notes.source: Recomputed from each actual completed episode and Decision context ledger during publication.
